questions.prompt: Which C# type represents true or false values?
questions.explanation: bool is the C# type for Boolean values (true or false).

questions.prompt: What is the default value of a bool variable in C#?
Arrange these types from smallest to largest memory footprint
questions.explanation: char (2 bytes) < int (4 bytes) < double (8 bytes) < string (reference, larger overhead).

questions.prompt: Which type is best for storing the value 3.14?
questions.explanation: double is a 64-bit floating-point type suitable for decimal values.

questions.prompt: Declare an int, double, bool, and string, then print their default values
How many bytes does a char occupy in C#?
questions.explanation: char is a Unicode character that occupies 2 bytes (16 bits).

questions.prompt: What is the default value of a string reference variable?
Which type stores single text characters?
questions.explanation: char stores a single Unicode character. string stores a sequence of characters.

questions.prompt: Arrange the default values for these types: int, bool, string, char
questions.explanation: int defaults to 0, bool to false, string to null, and char to '\0'.

questions.prompt: How many bytes does an int use in C#?
questions.explanation: int is a 32-bit signed integer and always uses 4 bytes.
